Package gov.cdc.izgateway.logging

Class RequestContext

java.lang.Object
gov.cdc.izgateway.logging.RequestContext
public class RequestContext extends Object
RequestContext is a class intended to provide access to variables relevant to the current request that we don't want to store in the MDC as the MDC variables get logged.
